Hafiz Travel & Tours Sdn. Bhd. (No. KPK/LN: 10751) is a licensed travel agency and Umrah operator registered under the Ministry of Tourism, Arts and Culture (MOTAC), officially established in 2022. With expertise and experience in the travel and Umrah management industry, we are committed to providing transparent, organised and professional pilgrimage and tour services.\n\nBased in Larkin, Johor Bahru, we have grown with the support of over 10 active branches across Johor, Melaka, Selangor, Kuala Lumpur, Perak, Penang, Kedah, Kelantan, Terengganu and Pahang, making it easier for pilgrims and customers nationwide.

Etiquette of Travel and Recommended Practices
Etiquette of traveling and performing prayers while on a journey.

A) Recommended Ritual Bath for Travelers
-Performed before setting out on a journey

Intention for the Bath:

نَوْيْتُ الْغُسْلَ لِلسَّفَرِ سُنَّةً لِلَّهِ تَعَالَى
I perform this ritual bath for travel, for the sake of Allah Ta'ala.

B) Voluntary Prayer for a Traveler (2 rak'ahs)
-1st Rakaat: Surah al-Fatihah + Surah al-Kafirun
-2nd Rak'ah: Surah al-Fatihah + Surah al-Ikhlas

Intention for Prayer:

أُصَلِّي سُنَّةَ السَّفَرِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ لِلَّهِ تَعَالَى
I perform the two-rakaat sunnah prayer for travel, for the sake of Allah Ta'ala.

B) Reading Before Leaving the House
-Ayat Kursi (1 time)
-Surah Quraysh (1 kali)
C) Supplication for Boarding a Vehicle

اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ وَالْخَلِيفَةُ فِي الْأَهْلِ وَالْمَالِ وَالْوَلَدِ وَالصَّحَابِ، اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنَا وَإِيَّاهُمْ مِنْ آفَاتِ الدُّنْيَا وَعَاهَاتِهَا، اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى، اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تَطْوِيَ لَنَا الْأَرْضَ وَتُؤْمِنَ عَلَيْنَا السَّفَرَ وَأَنْ تَرْزُقَنَا فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا سَلَامَةً فِي الْبَدَنِ وَالدِّينِ وَالْمَالِ وَتُبْلِغَنَا عُمْرَةَ بَيْتِكَ وَزِيَارَةَ قَبْرِ نَبِيِّكَ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ وَكَآبَةِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ بِسُوءِ الْمَنْظَرِ فِي الْأَهْلِ وَالْمَالِ وَالْوَلَدِ وَالصَّحَابِ، اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنَا وَإِيَّاهُمْ فِي جِوَارِكَ وَلَا تَسْلُبْنَا وَإِيَّاهُمْ نِعْمَتَكَ وَلَا تُغَيِّرْ مَا بِنَا وَبِهِمْ مِنْ عَافِيَتِكَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ.

Qasar Prayer: Shortening a 4-rakaah obligatory prayer (Dhuhr, Asr, Isha) to 2 rak'ahs.

Conditions for Qasar Prayer:

- A journey exceeding 2 marhalah (81 km)
- Knowing the destination
- Carried out after passing the district or city boundary.
- Travel is a must (not a vice)
- Does not intend to travel for four days or more (excluding the days of departure and return).

Implementation Options:

- Qasar only
- Jamak only
- Combination of Qasar and Jamak
Intention for Qasar Prayer:

JAMAK PRAYER: Combining two obligatory prayers into one time slot.
Prayers that can be combined: Zuhur with Asar, and Maghrib with Isyak. Subuh cannot be combined.
Two methods:

1. Jamak Taqdim (performed at the first prayer's time)
- Conditions: Order (perform the first prayer first), intend to combine the second prayer with the first at the start of takbir or before the salam of the first prayer, continuity (muwalat), and the journey must continue until the second prayer is completed.

Jamak Taqdim Intention (without qasar):

- Intention for Zuhur + Asar

أُصَلِّي فَرْضَ الظُّهْرِ أَرْبَعَ رَكَعَاتٍ مَجْمُوعًا إِلَيْهِ الْعَصْرُ أَدَاءً لِلَّهِ تَعَالَى
I hereby perform the obligatory Zuhur prayer, four rakaats, combined with the Asar prayer, for the sake of Allah Ta'ala

3. JAMAK COMBINED WITH QASAR:
You may combine two prayers at once while shortening Zuhur, Asar, and Isyak to two rakaat, following the conditions of both qasar and jamak.

Intention for Jamak Taqdim & Qasar:

Zuhur + Asar (at Zuhur time) - perform Zuhur first:

-Zuhur intention (qasar + jamak):

أُصَلِّي فَرْضَ الظَّهْرِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ قَصْرًا مَجْمُوعًا إِلَيْهِ الْعَصْرُ أَدَاءً لِلَّهِ تَعَالَى
I hereby perform the obligatory Zuhur prayer, two rakaats shortened, combined with the Asar prayer, for the sake of Allah Ta'ala

After the salam, Asar intention (qasar):

أُصَلِّي فَرْضَ الْعَصْرِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ قَصْرًا أَدَاءً لِلَّهِ تَعَالَى
I hereby perform the obligatory Asar prayer, two rakaats shortened, for the sake of Allah Ta'ala

-Definition: A visit to the House of Allah to perform worship under specific conditions.

-Ruling: Obligatory once in a lifetime for those who are able.

-Evidence: Hadith (Umrah during Ramadan equals the reward of Hajj) & Surah al-Baqarah 196.

-Etiquette before departure (14 matters): Sincerity, seeking knowledge, repentance, purifying one's wealth, settling debts/obligations, self-improvement, observing proper conduct, halal source of funds, sufficient provisions, seeking Allah's pleasure, choosing a suitable travel companion, praying for an accepted Umrah, the travel prayer, remembrance and reliance on Allah.

-Obligatory conditions: Muslim, of age, sane, free, safe journey, capable. For women: permission from husband/guardian & accompanied by a mahram or a trusted woman.
Step-by-step guide to performing Umrah, from ihram to sa\'i.

Recommended Acts Before Making the Ihram Intention

-Recommended bath for ihram
-Wearing ihram garments
-Applying fragrance
-Applying hair oil
-Performing the recommended ihram prayer

Recommended Acts While Making the Ihram Intention

-Facing the qiblah
-Being in a state of wudhu'

Recommended Acts After Making the Ihram Intention

-Reciting talbiyah, supplications, Qur'an, and dhikr
-Avoiding idle conversation

Ihram for Men
Wearing two unstitched sheets of cloth:
- One covering the awrah between the navel and the knees.
- The other worn as a shawl.
-Recommended to be white.

Ihram Intention for Umrah
Definition: The obligation to observe the ihram prohibitions from the moment of intention until the hair-cutting/shaving is completed.

Time of Intention:
-The most virtuous time is when the pilgrim is already on board the vehicle (following the example of the Prophet SAW).
-The intention may be made after completing the recommended ihram prayer.
-It is recommended to face the qiblah while pronouncing the intention.

How to Perform Tawaf

Upon arriving inside Masjid al-Haram to perform tawaf, pilgrims should proceed to the corner of the Black Stone (Hajar Aswad).

Pilgrims should walk toward the corner of the Black Stone, facing it, and it is recommended to make the intention for tawaf.

Wording of the Tawaf Intention for Umrah

اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أُرِيدُ طَوَافَ بَيْتِكَ الْحَرَامِ فَيَسِّرْهُ لِي وَتَقَبَّلْهُ مِنِّي سَبْعَةَ أَشْوَاطٍ طَوَافَ الْعُمْرَةِ لِلَّهِ تَعَالَى

After that, one should acknowledge the Black Stone with a hand gesture. Say:

بِسْمِ اللهِ وَاللهُ أَكْبَرُ وَلِلَّهِ الْحَمْدُ

If unable to get close due to large crowds, one may acknowledge it from a distance while reciting the above.

Pilgrims in ihram must not touch the Black Stone directly, as it has been perfumed.

How to Perform Sa'i

-Upon arriving at Mount Safa, face the direction of the Kaabah and make the intention for Sa'i.

Wording of the Sa'i Intention for Umrah:

اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَسْعَى بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرُوَةِ سَبْعَةَ أَشْوَاطٍ سَعْيَ الْعُمْرَةِ لِلَّهِ تَعَالَى

After the intention (still facing the qiblah), it is recommended to recite takbir:

اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ ، وَلِلَّهِ الْحَمْدُ

After the takbir, it is recommended to begin walking toward Mount Marwah while reciting the supplication:

اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ عَلَى هَدَانَا وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَلَى مَا أَوْلَانَا لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ أَنْجَزَ وَعْدَهُ وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ وَهَزَمَ الْأَحْزَابَ وَحْدَهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ

-It is recommended to pray for oneself or one's family, whether for worldly or hereafter matters, in one's own words.

-Then: begin the walk of Sa'i toward Mount Marwah.

-Meaning: removing/shedding hair on the head according to its valid conditions:

-Timing of shaving/cutting is after Sa'i
-Only the hair on the head
-Not less than 3 strands of hair
-More virtuous for men to shave completely; for women, it is sufficient to cut hair about the length of a fingertip
-If there is no hair, it is sufficient to simply pass a razor over the head

-Ihram Intention for Umrah
-Tawaf
-Sa'i
-Shaving/Cutting Hair
-Order (performing them in sequence)

Once all four pillars (intention, tawaf, sa'i, shaving/cutting) are completed in the correct order, the pilgrim is released from the ihram prohibitions and their Umrah is valid.

Consequence of not following the order: If Sa'i is performed before Tawaf, followed later by Tawaf and shaving, then that Sa'i and shaving are not valid. Pilgrims must perform all pillars correctly. If not done properly, a dam (penalty) of takhyir and taqdir applies for shaving before its proper time.
Performing a Second or Subsequent Umrah

-Performing a second or subsequent Umrah follows the same steps as the first.

-Pilgrims must travel out to the halal zone to make the ihram intention at a designated miqat such as Tan'im, Ji'ranah, or Hudaybiyah.

-It is recommended to perform the ihram bath before wearing ihram, then enter ihram for Umrah and perform the recommended ihram prayer at that miqat.

-Afterward, return to the city of Makkah to perform the Umrah tawaf, the recommended tawaf prayer, Sa'i, and hair-cutting. The supplications and recitations are the same as for the first Umrah.

-Recommended ihram bath - performed anywhere before making the intention (ruling: recommended).

-Wearing ihram garments - performed at the miqat (ruling: recommended).

-Recommended ihram prayer - performed at the miqat (ruling: recommended).

-Ihram intention for Umrah - performed at the miqat, effective from the intention until hair-cutting (ruling: pillar).

-Observing the ihram prohibitions - observed from the intention until the start of tawaf (ruling: obligatory).

-Talbiyah - recited at the House of Allah (ruling: recommended).

-Umrah Tawaf - performed at the House of Allah (ruling: pillar).

-Umrah Sa'i - performed at Mas'a (ruling: pillar).

-Shaving/Cutting Hair - performed at Marwah or anywhere (ruling: pillar).

-Performing all pillars in the correct order - performed anywhere (ruling: pillar).

-Obligatory for pilgrims who intend to leave the city of Makkah for the destinations mentioned.

Some related rulings:

-Pilgrims who leave Makkah without performing the farewell tawaf must return to complete it.

-If they return before covering a distance of 2 marhalah (81 km), no dam (penalty payment) is required.

-A person who leaves without performing the farewell tawaf without a valid excuse recognized by Islamic law is liable for a dam of tertib and taqdir.

-Once the farewell tawaf has been performed, one should no longer remain in Makkah; if they stay without necessity, the farewell tawaf is considered void and must be repeated.
Valid Excuses for Exemption from Farewell Tawaf

-Menstruation/postnatal bleeding
-Excessive bleeding wounds (that would soil the mosque)
-No water/earth available for purification
-Fear for life, honour, or property
-Fear of being left behind by companions
-Fear related to official duties
-Urinary incontinence
-Being forced to leave tawaf (emergency)
-Needing to be guided/carried (wheelchair not permitted in this context)
-Scheduled intensive medical treatment
-Officials who frequently travel in and out of Makkah

8 hours: Under normal circumstances, counted from arrival at the accommodation. If one does not leave Makkah within 8 hours without a valid travel reason, the tawaf must be repeated.\n\n24 hours: If a delay in transport is notified within 24 hours after the tawaf, it need not be repeated. Counted from arrival at the accommodation.

اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أُرِيدُ طَوَافَ بَيْتِكَ الْحَرَامِ طَوَافَ الْوَدَاعِ لِلَّهِ تَعَالَى

The method is the same as Umrah/recommended tawaf, except regular clothing is worn (not ihram) and the intention is for an obligatory tawaf.

After the tawaf:

-Perform the 2-rakaat recommended tawaf prayer (behind Maqam Ibrahim or anywhere in Masjid al-Haram).
-Supplicate at al-Multazam (using a transmitted supplication or one's own words).
-Drink Zamzam water and increase in supplication.

-Recommended Tawaf: Encouraged to be performed often. Intention: "O my Lord, I intend to perform 7 circuits of recommended tawaf..."

-Vow Tawaf: Intention: "O my Lord, I intend to perform 7 circuits of vow tawaf..."

-Tahiyyatul Bait (Greeting Tawaf): Most virtuous when entering Masjid al-Haram. Intention: "O my Lord, I intend to perform 7 circuits of tahiyyatul bait tawaf..."

-Throughout the journey and upon entering Madinah: Increase in sending blessings upon the Prophet and recite the supplication: "O Allah, make this city a protection from Hellfire and punishment."

-Upon entering the mosque: Recite the supplication for protection and seeking mercy.

-Tahiyyatul Masjid: 2 rakaat (rakaat 1: al-Kafirun, rakaat 2: al-Ikhlas), at al-Raudhah if possible, without disturbing other pilgrims.

Jannatul Baqi'

-The main cemetery of Madinah from the time of the Prophet SAW.

-The resting place of the Prophet's wives, daughters, and one of his sons.

-Recommended supplication: A greeting of peace to the inhabitants of the graves, seeking forgiveness for those who came before and after them, and asking that their reward not be withheld and that we not be tested after them.

Masjid Quba'

-The first mosque built by the Prophet SAW after the Hijrah, located 3 km south of Madinah.

-Merit: Praying in Masjid Quba' equals the reward of an Umrah (narrated by Ibn Majah).

-The Prophet SAW would regularly visit on Saturdays, and sometimes on Mondays and Thursdays.

-Built on a foundation of piety (Surah at-Taubah: 108).

Mount Uhud

-Located 5 km north of Madinah, known for the Battle of Uhud.

-The name "Uhud" means solitary (not connected to other mountains).

-Hadith: "Uhud is a mountain that loves us and we love it" (narrated by al-Bukhari).

-Contains the graves of Hamzah bin Abdul Muttalib, Abdullah bin Jahsy, Mus'ab bin Umair, and other martyrs of Uhud.

-Recommended to supplicate while visiting.

Masjid Qiblatain

-Formerly the mosque of Banu Salamah, the site where the change of qiblah occurred.

-While the Prophet SAW was leading the Zuhur prayer with the congregation, Surah al-Baqarah verse 144 was revealed, commanding that they face Masjid al-Haram.

-He turned from facing Baitulmaqdis toward the Kaabah, hence it is named the Mosque of the Two Qiblahs.

1. Pilgrims registering for double (2-bed) or triple (3-bed) rooms must specify their designated roommates during registration.
2. Pilgrims choosing quad (4-bed) or quint (5-bed) rooms must be prepared to upgrade (additional fee) to triple or double rooms if pairing quotas cannot be fulfilled.
